title: CNS1: code, result records, preregistrations and trained weights for a preregistered failure evaluation of deep bearing fault classifiers under strong noise
description: Code, per-instance result records, preregistrations (with SHA-256 checksums), verdicts and figure/table generators for the study of how training-file composition changes the strong-noise collapse class of deep bearing fault classifiers. Release v2.0.2 has the content of v2.0 (the corrected CWRU loader, the 99.mat audit, the C-INIT-FIX confirmation and the post-fix inference) plus licence, citation and archive metadata. Code is MIT-licensed; results, documents and trained weights are CC BY 4.0 (see LICENSE-DATA.md). Trained weights are attached to the GitHub releases v1.0 and v2.0.
notes: Supported by the Natural Science Foundation of Fujian Province, grant 2026J0011040.
